Walkthrough: where to begin

Start with your current objective. This opening guide helps you find your bearings, then points you to the detailed, independently published route.

Guide deskUpdated October 11, 20262 min read

Opening-game guidance only. This page is not a complete campaign walkthrough.

On this pageFind your placeThe opening routeStuck in the opening loop?Continue your run

Find your place

Check the Objectives menu rather than looking for a chapter number: the game uses named objectives. Keep a separate manual save before moving on.

The opening route

  1. Find Sunny
  2. Escape the Cult
  3. Take Back the Genesis Configuration
  4. Escape Charlotte

Stuck in the opening loop?

Hint A familiar-looking room does not necessarily mean the way forward is ahead.

Reveal solution
When the Labyrinth resembles a real room, turn around and re-enter the dark corridor.

Continue your run

Use the related guides below for individual locks and puzzles. For the complete objective-by-objective route, follow Gage’s walkthrough linked in the sources.
